$comment: Native package compliance reviews (D34). A person writes this file. No generator may.

A review answers whether the distribution obligations are met. scripts/native-inventory.mjs records what is IN a package; it can never set a status here, which is the point of the two files being separate.

To mark a review 'verified' it must carry evidence.licenseTextsRetained, evidence.sourceAvailability and evidence.linkingPosition, and boundToArtefactDigest must equal the artefactDigest of a current observation. If the binary changes, the digest changes and the review stops applying rather than being inherited.

proposedEvidence (D36) is different from evidence. It holds facts a machine assembled — the static linkage read, the retained SPDX texts, the recorded upstreams — so the reviewer has them to hand. It never moves a review towards verified. Signing a review means reading those facts, moving the ones you accept into evidence, and setting status; the validator rejects a verified review that still carries proposals.

Every entry below is unresolved. That is the true state: the libvips obligations have not been discharged, and npm run check:licenses:release fails because of it. Do not edit a status here to obtain a green run.
